translations.web: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate, with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.
translations.bsb: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities. The land and everything in it shuddered at the sound of his roaring.
translations.kjv: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
